meta.description: Decoder-free per-(axis, slot[, op-class]) Shannon entropy of CNC toolpath coordinates computed DIRECTLY from raw CAM G-code source files. No model, no decoder target-encoding, no NPZ. Methodology (regex, 6-slot grid, model_encode, entropy, classify_slot) matched to scripts/analysis/digit_entropy_analysis.py for comparability.

cnc_verdict.summary: High-order integer digits are near-deterministic across X/Y/Z (slot-0 entropy 0.00-0.00 bits, mass on '0'/'1'); the lowest decimal (10^-4) entropy per axis: X: 3.31 bits (high_entropy_quasi_uniform), Y: 3.31 bits (high_entropy_quasi_uniform), Z: 3.31 bits (high_entropy_quasi_uniform).
